The *Sabbamaṁsalābhajātaka* (Ja 315), titled in English translation as *One Who Gets All the Meat*, is a birth story preserved in the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. According to its opening context, the Buddha related the narrative while residing at Jetavana, prompted by the Venerable Sāriputta procuring dainty food for sick monastics who were undergoing medical treatment [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels are cataloged for this work on SuttaCentral, and automated alignments in DharmaNexus identify no cross-language matches [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Secondary references in the corpus only produced spurious citations of other works rather than scholarship on this Jātaka.
